name: SecLists
description: SecLists is the security tester's companion. It's a collection of multiple types of lists used during security assessments, collected in one place. List types include usernames, passwords, URLs, sensitive data patterns, fuzzing payloads, web shells, and many more.

issues.title: Modularize and change format of quickhits.txt
Create github action auto-updater for the SQLmap payloads classifier script

latest_release.body:
## Highlights

- feat(wordlist): Added Claude files to quickhits.txt (PR #1338)
- feat(wordlist): Added LureScope observed SSH credentials (PR #1342)
- feat(wordlist): Added risk-classified list of SQLi payloads
- feat(wordlist): Added template engine fuzzing wordlist (PR #1340)
- Various automatic wordlist updates, documentation improvements, and a few new payloads.
